title: Tireless Magnaguard
text: When Defeated: If this unit had 5 or more power, for this phase you may play this unit from your discard pile for free and give 2 Weakness tokens to it.
rules:
Tireless Magnaguard's ability references its power when it was defeated, which includes temporary modifiers.
“Play for free” ignores all resource costs, including the aspect penalty, but not other additional costs.
